title.en: Danna-sama ga Chicchai Mofumofu ni narimashita ~Watashi wo Akujo da to Gokai shiteita no ni, Subete Gibo no Uso da to Kizuita you desu~

altTitles.ja: 旦那様がちっちゃいモフモフになりました ～私を悪女だと誤解していたのに、すべて義母の嘘だと気づいたようです～

description.en:
“My Husband Turned into a Tiny, Adorable Creature – When He Discovered I Wasn’t the Villain He Thought!”
A noblewoman marries a famous duke, a heroic knight admired by all, believing she is destined for a happily ever after. But after two years of marriage, her life has become a living hell—her husband hates her, and she suffers constant abuse from his mother and sister.
The real reason behind this misery? Lies fed to him by his mother, who convinced him that she was a vain, cruel woman who mistreated the servants and lived in excess. Their marriage became nothing more than a cold, loveless contract.
But one day, while tending to the garden, she stumbles upon a tiny, fluffy creature—small enough to fit in her palm, with soft fur and familiar eyes… eyes that look exactly like her husband’s!
Before she can process the shock, she realizes the truth—her husband has been transformed by mysterious magic!
Now, in this helpless form, he is forced to witness the reality he had long refused to see. Slowly, he comes to understand that everything he believed was a lie!
Will this be their second chance to build a real relationship? Or will the curse that has befallen him uncover even deeper secrets?
A magical romance filled with misunderstandings, unexpected transformations, and heartwarming moments, where a neglected wife and a blinded husband embark on a new journey of love, redemption, and second chances!
